summary:
tui.hangup_exit_129 is fixed. run.argv_invalid_utf8 still fails as a recorded stack limitation; I did not work around it.

1. tui.hangup_exit_129, bare variant: I reproduced it on the pre-fix binary. A probe showed that when the pty master closes and nothing forwards SIGHUP, Bun emits stdin 'end' and 'close'. tui.ts only exited on SIGHUP, so the TUI kept running. The fix in <repo>/prototypes/ts/src/tui/tui.ts makes stdin 'end', 'close' or 'error' take the same restore-then-exit-129 path as SIGHUP. In raw mode Ctrl-D arrives as a byte, so tty EOF means the terminal is gone. The listeners are removed on exit. New native test 'K10: bare terminal hangup' uses test/bare_hangup.py, which runs the shim with --no-hup-forward. It failed on a pre-fix build (rc null, exit 1) and passes after the fix. In the harness, this check alone passed 3 times out of 3.

2. run.argv_invalid_utf8: Bun already holds U+FFFD in process.argv and Bun.argv before any user code runs (61 ff 62 arrives as 61 ef bf bd 62). The only route to the raw bytes is bun:ffi, which K8 forbids, so I recorded it as the stack limitation and made no change.
